fire: Every floor of the office is fitted with a fire suppression system.
The country is spending heavily on its missile interception program.
Engineers chose vacuum interrupters for arc suppression in the breaker.
Old lighthouses used a fog signal to warn ships near the rocks.
The town built a flood defense wall along the river last year.
Halon was once standard in fire extinguishing systems on aircraft.
The radar is part of a ballistic missile warning network.
Workers in the substation must wear arc flash protection suits.
quiet: Every floor of the office is fitted with a modern ventilation system.
The country is spending heavily on its space exploration program.
Engineers chose vacuum interrupters for the new breaker design.
Old lighthouses used a bright lamp to guide ships near the rocks.
The town built a new stone wall along the river last year.
Halon was once common in the cargo holds of older aircraft.
